name: Anima Automation
source:
You've been drifting through space for several years now with nothing to accompany you but silence and your new project... reviving your lover who left you all too soon. With completion right around the corner, what will happen? Will this be enough? Will you be happy?

[From [url=https://vinca-roseus.itch.io/anima-automation]itch.io[/url]]
